secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (https://<project>.supabase.co). Required for authenticated app routes; the public site and demo run without it.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public key. Paired with NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL for client + server auth.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service-role key for server-side admin access. Only needed for production adapters.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key (sk_...). Only needed when billing integrations are enabled.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...). Only needed when Stripe webhooks are enabled.

secrets.name: CRON_SECRET
secrets.description: High-entropy secret protecting cron routes. Only needed when cron adapters are enabled.
